docs.text:
Harriet Jacobs's story of seven years in hiding and her escape from slavery in North Carolina.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Harriet Jacobs (1813–1897), writing as Linda Brent, Incidents in the Life of a Slave Girl, 1861. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
